requirements.title: Identify a rock
requirements.description: The app shall identify a rock from a photo fast and be user-friendly.

requirements.title: Image formats
requirements.description: The app shall accept JPEG, PNG, etc.
requirements.fit_criterion: JPEG and PNG files up to 10 MB are accepted

user_stories.goal: identify a rock from a photo

acceptance_criteria.title: Result is shown
given: I have taken a photo of a rock
then: the rock type is shown quickly

acceptance_criteria.title: Unreadable photo
then: the error 'Photo too dark' is shown and the confidence threshold is not applied
